```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

# Functions
Rounding with the round() function

```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```

# Arguments
Changing the argument order

```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
# Change order
print(rep(times = 7, x = 5))
```

# Variables
Types of variables

```{r}
number <- 12
text <- "Hello"
boolean <- TRUE

# Check variable type
print(class(number))
print(class(text))
print(class(boolean))
```

Variables example for an experiment

```{r}
cell_ID_1 = 'CX1'
cell_ID_2 = 'CX2'
treated_1 = TRUE
treated_2 = FALSE
num_cells_before_1 = 5415
num_cells_before_2 = 8123
num_cells_after_1 = 1432
num_cells_after_2 = 7543
```

# Vectors
Make earlier values into a vector

```{r}
cell_ID_vec = c(cell_ID_1, cell_ID_2)
treated_vec = c(treated_1, treated_2)
num_cells_before_vec = c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
num_cells_after_vec = c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)
```

Indexing vectors

```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
print(all_my_pets[4])
```

# Dataframes
Make a dataframe with tibble

```{r}
df <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_ID_vec,
  treated = treated_vec,
  num_cells_before = num_cells_before_vec,
  num_cells_after = num_cells_after_vec
)

gt(df)
```
